name: To Silence Hunger and Noise
source:
You’re a jiangshi, who feeds on others to sustain yourself. After your hunger returns, you seek shelter alone in an elevator.

But you’re not alone.

[From [url=https://the-cottage-workshop.itch.io/to-silence-hunger-and-noise]Itch.io[/url]]
